title: Builder Conflicts
description: Check for potential conflicts between multiple page builders.
recommendation: Use only one page builder to prevent conflicts and performance issues.

success.title: No Builder Conflicts
success.details: No conflicts detected between page builders. Your site is using a single page builder efficiently.

error.title: Builder Conflicts Detected
error.details: Multiple page builders detected. This can cause conflicts and performance issues.

learn_more.description: Running multiple page builders can lead to conflicts, slower performance, and maintenance challenges.
